llm.evidence: The HPLC was coupled to a Q-Exactive Plus (Thermo Scientific, Bremen, Germany) mass spectrometer. Mass spectra were acquired manually using an ultraflex TOF/TOF mass spectrometer (MS)
peptides were separated on an EASY nanoLC 1000 UPLC system (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Waltham, MA) using RPC18 columns
extracts were desalted using self-packed Stage Tip C18 (IVA Analysentechnik e.K., Meerbusch, Germany) spin columns.
MS data were acquired in a top10 data-dependent method dynamically choosing the most abundant peptide ions
HCD spectra were measured with a resolution of 35 000, AGC target at 3e6, maximum injection time at 240 ms, 28 eV normalized collision energy, and dynamic exclusion set at 25 s.
